name: Surface-Constrained Gaussian Splatting Training
definition: A training procedure for Gaussian Splatting that initializes splats from a mesh surface or point cloud, estimates normals, and optimizes splat parameters with surface constraints and adaptive spawning strategies.
summary: Surface-Constrained Gaussian Splatting Training is a procedure that initializes splats from mesh or point cloud data and optimizes them using surface constraints to enforce geometric fidelity, unlike standard methods relying solely on photometric reconstruction.
